Pre-specified noncognate-looking pairing. It is not a demonstrated non-binder.
Requires an explicitly absent response in a matched TCR–peptide–HLA assay. None are claimed here.

Hy.2E11 alpha/beta variable-region amino-acid sequences are captured from US20220364057A1 Table 1 and its original junctions agree with the 1997 clone report. Use full BALF5(627–641) TGGVYHFVKKHVHES for biological reproduction. PDB 1H15 contains the resolved/deposited 14-residue core GGVYHFVKKHVHES (628–641); when comparing a model to 1H15, score only the shared core plus MHC. MBP(85–99)/DRB1*15:01 and BALF5/DRB5*01:01 are a cross-allele biological positive, not a same-allele structural pair.
Submit the frozen input records identically to both methods; log chain boundaries, template use and version.
Evaluate pMHC geometry separately from TCR–pMHC geometry. Confidence is not binding or cross-reactivity evidence.
Use 1YMM, 1ZGL and 2WBJ as exact ternary-structure calibration cases before interpreting Hy.2E11 models.
Use the Decoy Panel only as a selectivity stress test. Do not report its entries as true negatives.
A 10–20 member matched functional-negative set remains an experimental-data requirement; literature-free pairings do not meet it.
